metadata.configuration: TpMarkdownParser defaults; renderAsync; no Pandoc; no browser runtime
metadata.interpretation: All 66 remaining differences in this corpus result from deliberate TP Markdown implementation choices: generated heading attributes, typographic substitutions, automatic links and YAML frontmatter recognition. They remain counted as differences in the strict CommonMark comparison; this does not imply full CommonMark conformance.

differenceTypes.label: Generated heading attributes only
differenceTypes.description: TP adds id and tabindex to headings. Removing only those attributes makes the normalized HTML identical.

differenceTypes.label: Typographic substitutions
differenceTypes.description: Straight quotes and apostrophes become curly quotes; double or triple hyphens become dashes. These are default typographer transformations, not changes to block structure.

differenceTypes.label: YAML frontmatter recognition
differenceTypes.description: Initial lines between --- delimiters are consumed as frontmatter instead of remaining thematic breaks and heading content. Example 96 also has generated heading attributes.

differenceTypes.label: Automatic links (linkify)
differenceTypes.description: Bare URLs and an email address become links, including URLs inside text that is not a valid CommonMark autolink.
